about_the_game:
Letters To A Beloved Ghost: This add-on for the FREE indie visual novel Entropic Float adds over 150k words of new content and over 100 pieces of brand new original art for you to enjoy after completing the main story!

Box Hako is a mysterious woman reaching out to you personally- She hopes to increase your presence in her world through showing you as many stories as she can about people both familiar and unfamiliar to you! Read her letters for the chance to speak directly to her and deepen your understanding of Entropic Float's world. Uncover secrets, get to know characters better, and prime yourself for the plots of future games.

content_descriptors.notes: This DLC tackles mature topics including but not limited to abuse, self-harm, disability, and bigotry. There is an option to receive a more specific content warning prior to each side story.
